description_en: Queries a list of context stores
name: ListContextStores

parameters.help_en: The name of the AgentSpace. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: AgentSpace 名称，长度 2-64 字符
parameters.name: agent_space

parameters.help_en: Filters context stores by name. Exact match is supported. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering is applied
parameters.help_zh: 按上下文库名称过滤，支持精确匹配；不传表示不过滤
parameters.name: context_store_name

parameters.help_en: Filters context stores by type, such as experience or memory. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering is applied
parameters.help_zh: 按上下文库类型过滤，例如 experience / memory；不传表示不过滤
parameters.name: context_type

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of context stores to return. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 本次最多返回的上下文库条数，默认 20，最大 100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the nextToken value returned in the previous response to retrieve the next page. Do not specify this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 分页 Token，传入上一次响应中的 nextToken 翻页；首次请求不传
parameters.name: next_token

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page that was specified in the request. This value is echoed back
maxResults.description_zh: 请求时传入的本页最大条数，回显
maxResults.title_en: 请求时传入的本页最大条数，回显
maxResults.title_zh: 请求时传入的本页最大条数，回显

nextToken.description_en: The token for the next page. An empty string indicates that the current page is the last page
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页 Token，空字符串表示已经是最后一页
nextToken.title_en: 下一页 Token，空字符串表示已经是最后一页
nextToken.title_zh: 下一页 Token，空字符串表示已经是最后一页

requestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to locate and troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求 Id，用于排查问题时定位本次请求
requestId.title_en: 请求 Id，用于排查问题时定位本次请求
requestId.title_zh: 请求 Id，用于排查问题时定位本次请求

agentSpace.description_en: The name of the AgentSpace to which the context store belongs

contextStoreName.description_en: The name of the context store

contextType.description_en: The type of the context store, such as experience or memory
contextType.description_zh: 上下文库类型，例如 experience / memory
contextType.title_en: 上下文库类型，例如 experience / memory
contextType.title_zh: 上下文库类型，例如 experience / memory

createTime.description_en: The time when the context store was created, in ISO 8601 UTC format
createTime.description_zh: 上下文库创建时间，ISO 8601 UTC 格式
createTime.title_en: 上下文库创建时间，ISO 8601 UTC 格式
createTime.title_zh: 上下文库创建时间，ISO 8601 UTC 格式

description.description_en: The description of the context store

regionId.description_en: The region ID of the context store
regionId.description_zh: 上下文库所在地域 Id
regionId.title_en: 上下文库所在地域 Id
regionId.title_zh: 上下文库所在地域 Id

serviceNames.description_en: The list of service names. This parameter has a value only for context stores of the experience type. The service names are used together with the data source AgentSpace to locate trace data sources
serviceNames.description_zh: 服务名列表（仅 experience 类型有值）；与数据源 AgentSpace 协同定位 trace 数据源
serviceNames.title_en: 服务名列表（仅 experience 类型有值）；与数据源 AgentSpace 协同定位 trace 数据源
serviceNames.title_zh: 服务名列表（仅 experience 类型有值）；与数据源 AgentSpace 协同定位 trace 数据源

status.description_en: The status of the context store. Valid values: ACTIVE, INITIALIZING, and FAILED
status.description_zh: 上下文库状态，枚举值，例如 ACTIVE / INITIALIZING / FAILED
status.title_en: 上下文库状态，枚举值，例如 ACTIVE / INITIALIZING / FAILED
status.title_zh: 上下文库状态，枚举值，例如 ACTIVE / INITIALIZING / FAILED

updateTime.description_en: The time when the context store was last updated, in ISO 8601 UTC format
updateTime.description_zh: 上下文库最近一次更新时间，ISO 8601 UTC 格式
updateTime.title_en: 上下文库最近一次更新时间，ISO 8601 UTC 格式
updateTime.title_zh: 上下文库最近一次更新时间，ISO 8601 UTC 格式

total.description_en: The total number of context stores that match the query conditions
total.description_zh: 符合查询条件的上下文库总数
total.title_en: 符合查询条件的上下文库总数
total.title_zh: 符合查询条件的上下文库总数
